newsitem.title: USA: Double Day to buy back up to 21 pct of stk.
newsitem.headline: Double Day to buy back up to 21 pct of stk.

text.p: Double Day Inc said Wednesday its board had authorized the repurchase of up to three million shares, or 21 percent of its issued and outstanding common stock.
Repurchases will take place in private or market transactions during the next 18 months, it said.
The board said its decision was in keeping with its responsibility to maximize shareholder value and was based on the belief that the stock is undervalued.
George Lodick Jr, president of Double Day, said funds for the repurchases will be generated by the non-recurring sale of equity interests in its coal briquetting and pelletizing plants.
Double Day specializes in the recycling of non-hazardous industrial wastes and by-products.
